name: zhouyou-map
description: 周游地图（Zhouyou Map）—— 跨平台中国旅行足迹地图、旅行手账与多模型 AI 行程规划器
author: Eldonwyd

scripts.build:hot-update: npm run build && npm run build:electron-server && node scripts/build-hot-update.mjs
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && npm run build:electron-server && electron .
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build && npm run build:electron-server && electron-builder --config electron/electron-builder.yml --dir
scripts.desktop:win: npm run build && npm run build:electron-server && electron-builder --config electron/electron-builder.yml --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:mac: npm run build && npm run build:electron-server && electron-builder --config electron/electron-builder.yml --mac --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:linux: npm run build && npm run build:electron-server && electron-builder --config electron/electron-builder.yml --linux --x64 --publish never
scripts.mobile:android: npm run build && (npx cap add android || true) && node scripts/prepare-mobile.mjs android && npx cap sync android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run build && (npx cap add ios || true) && node scripts/prepare-mobile.mjs ios && npx cap sync ios
scripts.test:planner: node scripts/planner-domain-test.mjs && node scripts/planner-display-test.mjs && node scripts/planner-normalize-test.mjs && node scripts/planner-normalize-activity-test.mjs && node scripts/planner-service-test.mjs && node scripts/ai-subscriptions-test.mjs && node scripts/planner-xhs-import-test.mjs && node scripts/planner-photo-test.mjs && node scripts/planner-photo-cover-test.mjs && node scripts/planner-options-map-test.mjs && node scripts/planner-smoke.mjs && node scripts/planner-options-map-smoke.mjs && node scripts/planner-photo-smoke.mjs && node scripts/planner-launcher-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:photos: node scripts/planner-photo-test.mjs && node scripts/planner-xhs-test.mjs && node scripts/planner-photo-speed-test.mjs && node scripts/planner-photo-cover-test.mjs && node scripts/photo-inspector-test.mjs && node scripts/planner-photo-smoke.mjs
